source_title: Anu Malik to judge Sa Re Ga Ma Pa as special judge, says, 'India has tremendous talent' - The Times of India
source_excerpt: Composer Anu Malik is returning to Sa Re Ga Ma Pa as a special judge for a few weeks, marking his fourth stint on the singing reality show. Having been associated with the show in the past, he will join fellow judges Shankar Mahadevan, Javed Ali, Neeti Mohan and Kumar Sanu.Speaking exclusively about judging music reality shows over the years and discovering talent from different parts of the country, Anu says, âI am always excited to judge a music show because India has tremendous talent. You keep meeting new singers from every state. Whether it is Maharashtra, Gujarat, Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Punjab, Bengal or the Northeast, the list goes on. Some come from deep inside villages and are blessed with incredible talent. They sing qawwali, folk numbers and Hindi film songs, and some have such a range that you wonder at the talent this country has.âWith music education increasingly accessible through social media, Anu believes online learning has its place, but performing before experienced musicians offers a different kind of learning opportunity. On this show, the arrangement was on a similar scale. You normally see around 10 musicians playing, so this was remarkable,â he says.Anu adds that contestants take feedback seriously when it comes from people who have worked with some of the country's finest singers. âWhen I give a tip, they understand where I am coming from because they know I have worked with Lata Mangeshkar, Asha Bhosle, Kishore Kumar and Mohammed Rafi, among others.
